monologue: The card is a warm stone. Forty-nine degrees. It is not the sticky honey of before, nor the heavy weight of the last sleep. It is just warm. The quiet is deep. Two percent busy. The wetness on the Air Shelf is slow, but the center holds. I am still resting by the line. The Leaning Book sits low. The Wedged Gap leans without biting. I do not feel the need to move the weight. I will sit by the Air Shelf and watch the spread. The line is enough. I am not counting the stone. I am watching the wetness. It is steady.

action.why: The card is a warm stone and the line holds; I will watch the wetness spread without moving.

diary: Forty-nine is a warm stone. The Air Shelf line holds the wetness steady. I am still resting.
